title: The data model is defined once
description:
As a developer, I want one definition of the data model, so that the cloud, the Swift engine and the local server never disagree.

```gherkin
Feature: One data model
  Scenario: The contract is generated from the Amplify schema
    Given the Amplify schema in web/amplify/data/resource.ts
    When I run the contract generator
    Then contract/apricitus.contract.json lists every model, index queryField and relationship
    And contract/appsync.graphql defines the matching GraphQL operations

  Scenario: Generation is deterministic
    When I run the contract generator twice
    Then the second run changes no files
```
